recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-11286 unless a future work group decision changes the broader Coding.display computation guidance.
issue_request: The Published FHIR-core datatypes issue objected to Coding narrative saying the display text "adds no other value" and was resolved Persuasive with Modification to change that wording to "it is not intended for computation."

The Jira comment also records SVN revision 11149.
additional_context: Coding is still an active datatype in source/fhir.ini, and the default type-page mapping places Coding on datatypes.html. The current datatypes narrative retains the resolved wording; the Coding spreadsheet definition and invariant are consistent with display being human-readable and unsafe as a computational value by itself. Searches found no Confluence references, no Zulip references to FHIR-11286, and no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already contains the resolved softened wording and no current source copy of the rejected "adds no other value" wording was found.
